paypal-sandbox.headersHelper:
[ -f .env ] || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }
CACHE=".paypal_token_cache.json"
if [ -f "$CACHE" ]; then
  MTIME=$(stat -f %m "$CACHE" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$CACHE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  AGE=$(( $(date +%s) - MTIME ))
  if [ "$AGE" -lt 28800 ]; then cat "$CACHE"; exit 0; fi
fi
CID=$(grep -m1 '^PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//' -e "s/^'//" -e "s/'$//")
CSEC=$(grep -m1 '^PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//' -e "s/^'//" -e "s/'$//")
[ -n "$CID" ] && [ -n "$CSEC" ] || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }
TOKEN=$(curl -s -m 8 -u "$CID:$CSEC" -d grant_type=client_credentials https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/oauth2/token | sed -n 's/.*"access_token"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
[ -n "$TOKEN" ] || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }
(umask 077; printf '{"Authorization":"Bearer %s"}' "$TOKEN" > "$CACHE")
chmod 600 "$CACHE" 2>/dev/null
cat "$CACHE"
